latest_release.name: DiPlay 0.2.22 — public preview
latest_release.body:
# DiPlay 0.2.22 — 2026-10-28

Public preview for compatible BYD Android head units. Android 7.0+ (API 24); on Android 7.0–8.1, wired CarPlay is confirmed on one car (a 2020 BYD Han EV with DiLink 2.0) and wireless still needs vehicle testing. This update fixes the two problems 0.2.21 introduced, wireless CarPlay over the car hotspot on BYD DiLink 3.0 and 4.0 and music playing too fast, makes USB voice recordings work, has the CarPlay screen and Home say why a connection fails, adds Korean and Turkish, and hardens DiPlay against bad input from other devices and apps.

## Highlights

- Wireless CarPlay over the car hotspot connects again on BYD DiLink 3.0 and 4.0 head units where 0.2.21 picked a mobile-data interface and stayed on "Opening CarPlay". The **Hotspot interface (optional)** workaround can be cleared. [#936](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/936), [#950](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/950)
- Music plays at the iPhone's speed again over Wi-Fi, from the first second of every song: no more 1.5 % speed-up followed by stutter. [#993](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/993), [#1070](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1070), [#1080](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1080)
- Over USB, WeChat voice messages, Voice Memos and dictation record the driver's voice instead of silence. [#1148](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1148)
- Wired CarPlay connects on the first attempt after a replug or a reconnect with the cable in, and auto-start brings CarPlay to the front when it is already connecting. [#962](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/962), [#1057](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1057), [#1085](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1085)
- The CarPlay screen names the cause of a failed connection, such as an iPhone that is no longer paired, a car hotspot that is off or differs from the saved one, or a car that sees no USB device, with what to change; Home keeps the last problem until CarPlay connects. [#1058](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1058), [#1060](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1060), [#1062](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1062), [#1066](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1066)
- DiPlay is available in Korean and Turkish. New options, off by default: keep CarPlay in the launcher card, navigation prompts that ask for audio focus, calls at the call's own rate, a full-screen dashboard map on DiLink 3.0, and the dashboard map on the Denza N9. [#1105](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1105), [#999](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/999), [#1052](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1052), [#1051](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1051), [#898](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/898), [#956](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/956), [#1049](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/pull/1049)

## Fixes for 0.2.21

- Wireless CarPlay over the built-in car hotspot connects again on head units where Android cannot say which interface carries the hotspot. On BYD DiLink 3.0 and 4.0 units the hotspot runs on `wlan0` while the firmware's Wi-Fi patterns name only `softap0` and `wigig0`, and on an MG7 it runs on `ath0`. 0.2.21 then took a mobile-data interface (`rmnet_data…`) or an internal bridge (`br0`) for the hotspot, so the iPhone joined the hotspot but never reached DiPlay and CarPlay stayed on "Opening CarPlay" ([#921](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/921), [#931](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/931), [#944](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/944), [#951](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/951), [#955](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/955), [#958](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/958), [#991](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/991), [#1019](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/1019)). DiPlay again uses the interface 0.2.20 us

detail.readme:
# DiPlay

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md)

**CarPlay for compatible BYD Android head units.** Wired and wireless, with the familiar DiAuto interface. Independent app: `com.shihab.diplay`.

> **BYD support scope:** These projects focus on BYD cars. They may work on other brands, but other brands are unsupported and there are no plans to add support or fix brand-specific incompatibilities.

[Download & website](https://shihabal3amri.github.io/DiPlay/) · [Release](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/releases/tag/v0.2.22) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/new/choose)

![DiPlay home](site/assets/home.png)

## 0.2.22 — public preview

Install on the **car**, not the iPhone. No jailbreak, dongle, Mac, account or authentication server is required for use. Core CarPlay does not require ADB; optional dashboard, battery, wheel-speed and parked-video features do. Your head unit must permit APK installation. The APK supports Android 7.0+ (API 24); on Android 7.0–8.1, wired CarPlay is confirmed on one car and wireless is not yet confirmed on a vehicle. Wireless supports Wi-Fi Direct, the car’s existing hotspot or Existing Wi-Fi / Same LAN. Android 7.0–9 Wi-Fi Direct uses a firmware-dependent legacy path with generated group credentials and unverified requested frequency; see [Android 9 Wi-Fi Direct](docs/ANDROID9_WIFI_DIRECT.md). Android 10+ verifies its negotiated group frequency.

- Wired USB and wireless CarPlay with local authentication.
- BYD HUD navigation with arrows, distance and street names on verified firmware.
- Car hotspot support, improved audio buffering and saved receive diagnostics.
- Automatic address discovery, fixed-channel Wi-Fi fallbacks and successful-configuration memory.
- Icon/text size, resolution and frame rate; applying a display change reconnects CarPlay.
- Local diagnostic export. Reports are sent only if you choose to share them.
- Separate installation alongside DiAuto. Run one projection app at a time.

This is **not an Apple-certified product**. The APK bundles an experimental accessory identity recovered from public Carlinkit firmware, not a newly provisioned MFi identity for DiPlay. A bundled private key is extractable. Acceptance after future iOS updates, reliability across head units and suitability of that identity for general distribution are unresolved. This release invites community testing; it is not a guarantee of universal compatibility.

Earlier releases were tested on the development DiLink5.1 car: live windshield guidance and street names work, Car hotspot now starts CarPlay, and Wi-Fi Direct performance is substantially improved. Audio underrun recovery is improved in 0.2.15; remaining cutouts need current diagnostic reports. The 0.2.16 software Opus microphone fallback was accepted on a BOS Mini A1 head unit (Android 9) with an iPhone 12 on iOS 27. The floating-map test build was installed on the development DiLink 5.1 car; feedback led to the pinch corrections in 0.2.9. Earlier wheel-speed and video contributions were tested on a BYD Tang with DiLink 5.0 and an iPhone 15 Pro on iOS 27; wheel-speed dead reckoning in tunnels remains unverified. Broader head-unit and iOS compatibility is not guaranteed. The HUD firmware scope and cleanup limits are documented in [BYD navigation](docs/BYD_NAVIGATION.md).

## What’s new in 0.2.22

- Wireless CarPlay over the car hotspot connects again on BYD DiLink 3.0 and 4.0 head units where 0.2.21 stayed on "Opening CarPlay"; the **Hotspot interface (optional)** workaround can be cleared.
- Music plays at the iPhone's speed over Wi-Fi again, from the first second of every song, without the 0.2.21 speed-up and stutter.
- Over USB, WeChat voice messages, Voice Memos and dictation record your voice instead of silence.
- Wired CarPlay connects on the first attempt after a replug, and the CarPlay screen and Home say why a connection failed and what to change.
- DiPlay is available in Korean and Turkish.
- New options, off by default: keep CarPlay in the launcher card, navigation prompts that ask for audio focus, calls at the call's own rate, a full-screen DiLink 3.0 dashboard map and the dashboard map on the Denza N9.

See [0.2.22 release notes](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.22.md) and [validation](docs/VALIDATION.md) for contribution links and remaining physical tests. General stutter, calls/Siri, decoder and model-specific reports still need current-device evidence. [0.2.21 notes](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.21.md) remain available as historical guidance.

If a problem remains, reproduce it on **0.2.22**, then use **Settings → Diagnostics → Save diagnostic report**. Android 10+ normally saves to **Downloads/DiPlay**; Android 7.0–9 asks for storage access and saves there too. If unavailable, use **View report** or **Share** from the confirmation, which identifies external/private fallback storage. Review the `.txt` and attach it as a file to a matching [existing issue](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues), or [create one](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/new/choose). Include vehicle/head-unit model, exact firmware and Android/DiLink, phone/iOS, connection backend, relevant settings, steps and failure time. Reports are shared only when you choose; never post your hotspot password.

## Documentation

[Existing Wi-Fi / Same LAN](docs/EXISTING_WIFI.md) keeps the iPhone and head unit
on an external router. See the guide for setup, build requirements and the
BYD DiLink 4.0 / Android 10 clean-install validation result.

- [Install and connect](docs/INSTALL.md)
- [Compatibility and troubleshooting](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)
- [Smooth wireless CarPlay](docs/SMOOTH_WIRELESS.md)
- [Privacy and diagnostic reports](docs/PRIVACY.md)
- [Build from source](docs/BUILD.md) — select `mobile` for the main DiPlay app; `maphost` is a map sample.
- [Validation](docs/VALIDATION.md)
- [Release notes](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Credits and licenses](docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

The app and the website include English, Arabic, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), Japanese, Italian, Korean and Turkish. Traditional Chinese uses Taiwan wording; the app also recognizes Hong Kong/Macao and explicit Hant selections without claiming separate regional translations. Choose the app language in Settings; on Android 13+, it stays synchronized with Android’s per-app language setting. See the [Traditional Chinese guide](README.zh-TW.md) for installation, settings, troubleshooting, privacy and build instructions.

## Source and credits

Based on [xcertplay](https://github.com/shilapi/xcertplay), GPL-3.0. The home/settings UI and website adapt [DiAuto](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiAuto), AGPL-3.0; that license is included in `docs/licenses`. Preserve those notices when distributing modifications. CarPlay and its icon belong to Apple Inc.; no Apple or BYD affiliation or endorsement is implied.

This repository starts with a clean public source snapshot. Local research, tester reports and release-signing secrets are excluded. The complete source corresponding to the APK is provided with every release; experimental runtime identity assets are described separately in the build instructions and notices.

## Local release packaging

The release APK intentionally contains the experimental accessory identity. The Git repository and source archive exclude all accessory and Android signing keys; tests generate synthetic identities at runtime. Source/CI builds omit runtime identity assets by default. Local release builds explicitly select an external asset directory. Publishing the APK makes its bundled identity extractable; building locally does not preserve that identity's confidentiality.
detail.readme_zh:
# DiPlay

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md)

为兼容的比亚迪安卓车机提供有线及无线 CarPlay，采用 DiAuto 风格界面。

> 这些项目专注于比亚迪汽车。它们可能在其他品牌上运行，但其他品牌不在支持范围内，也没有增加支持或修复其品牌特定兼容性问题的计划。

[下载与中文网站](https://shihabal3amri.github.io/DiPlay/zh-Hans/) · [0.2.22 版本](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/releases/tag/v0.2.22) · [完整说明](README.md) · [报告问题](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/new/choose)

## 0.2.22 — 公开预览版

请安装在允许 APK 安装的 Android 7.0+（API 24+）车机上；Android 7.0–8.1 上的有线 CarPlay 已在一台实车上确认，无线连接尚未经实车验证。无需越狱、转接盒、账户或认证服务器。有线及无线核心连接不要求 ADB；可选车辆数据及车辆控制需要支持的固件和已授权网络 ADB。

Wi-Fi Direct 现支持 Android 7.0–9 的旧版建组路径，使用系统返回的真实凭据。首选信道依赖固件 API；Android 7.0–9 无法读回协商频率，所以请求信道在诊断中标为未经验证，系统默认为信道 0。Android 10+ 保留频率验证。也可使用车机内置热点、USB 或[现有 Wi-Fi／同一局域网](docs/EXISTING_WIFI.md)；同一局域网模式由车机和 iPhone 自行连接外部路由器，DiPlay 不替你修改默认路由。[Android 9 Wi-Fi Direct 限制](docs/ANDROID9_WIFI_DIRECT.md)说明清理及持久配置边界。

### 新增与修正

- **车机热点**：修正 0.2.21 在比亚迪 DiLink 3.0／4.0 等车机上通过车机热点无线连接时一直停在“正在打开 CarPlay”的问题；之前填写的“热点网络接口（可选）”可以清空。
- **音乐**：通过 Wi-Fi 播放音乐时恢复 iPhone 的原始速度，每首歌从第一秒起就不再先快 1.5% 再卡顿。
- **麦克风**：USB 连接时，微信语音、语音备忘录和听写能录到声音，不再是静音。
- **连接**：插着线重新连接时，有线 CarPlay 第一次就能连上；连接失败时，CarPlay 画面和主页会说明原因以及应该怎么改。
- **语言**：新增韩语和土耳其语。
- **新选项（默认关闭）**：在桌面卡片中保留 CarPlay、导航提示音请求音频焦点、按通话本身的采样率通话、DiLink 3.0 全屏仪表地图，以及腾势 N9 的仪表地图。

[0.2.22 完整说明](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.22.md)包含贡献链接及功能限制；构建和验证信息见[验证记录](docs/VALIDATION.md)。Android 7.0–8.1 尚需实车验证，不宣称所有车型的连接、音频或 Siri 问题均已解决。可选功能请停车后测试。

### 请提供 0.2.22 的新诊断报告

1. 更新到 **0.2.22**，复现问题并记录发生时间。开机／自动启动问题发生后，可手动打开 DiPlay 导出。
2. 打开“**设置 → 诊断 → 保存诊断报告**”。Android 10+ 通常保存到 **Downloads/DiPlay**；Android 7.0–9 会请求存储权限并同样保存到该位置，也可点“选择保存位置”。如选择器或公共存储不可用，应用会使用专用外部或私有目录，并在确认中说明目的地。
3. 使用确认中的**查看报告／分享**；没有分享应用时，可在报告视图中选择并复制文本。检查 `.txt` 并删除隐私信息，再附到匹配的[现有问题](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues)，或[新建问题](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay/issues/new/choose)。报告不会自动上传，请勿公开热点密码或私有认证文件。
4. 注明车型／车机、DiLink/Android/完整固件版本、iPhone/iOS、USB／车机热点／Wi-Fi Direct／同一局域网、相关设置、复现步骤、预期与实际结果及故障时间。

[从源码构建](docs/BUILD.md)：主应用请选择 `mobile` 模块。`maphost` 是地图演示应用，构建步骤和 APK 路径见说明。

历史记录：[0.2.17](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.17.md)、[0.2.16](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.16.md)、[0.2.15](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.15.md)、[0.2.14](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.14.md)、[0.2.13](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.13.md)、[0.2.12](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.12.md)、[0.2.11](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.2.11.md)、[安装与连接](docs/INSTALL.md)。

这是公开预览版，**未经 Apple 认证**。APK 使用从公开 Carlinkit 固件中提取的既有实验性配件身份，并非为 DiPlay 新签发的 MFi 身份；其中的私钥可被提取，未来 iOS 是否继续接受及其公开分发适用性尚未确定。Android 签名密钥和配件身份不进入 Git 或源代码压缩包；普通源代码/CI 构建默认不配置身份。部分车机仍可能卡顿或无法应用图标大小设置。

标准导航小组件需要支持 Android 小组件的启动器；比亚迪内置主页不接受任意小组件。悬浮地图和嵌入地图需要启用“CarPlay 仪表地图”。应用和网站都包含十一种语言：英语、简体中文、繁体中文（台湾）、阿拉伯语、俄语、乌克兰语、西班牙语、日语、意大利语、韩语和土耳其语。应用的香港／澳门及 Hant 选择使用台湾译文，不宣称提供独立地区翻译。[繁体中文说明](README.zh-TW.md)提供安装、设置、隐私和构建指南。源代码、构建说明及许可证随版本提供。
